title: Normalize S Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize the "s" plugin crate (s/plugin/rs/lib.rs, s/**) to the Consistency Contract for the app-framework generalization wave: C1 app-struct naming (PascalCase(app id)+App), C2 exactly one 🔖Manifest region, C3 region formatting/canonical order, C4 split the two flat apps (SHomeApp, SStudioApp) into pub mod app_home / pub mod app_studio with shared code flat, C5 adopt SDK-only mechanisms from semio_framework_plugin (PanelKit tree builders, Terminology app_labels!/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt, Testkit meta/new_app/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge) removing this crate's hand-rolled equivalents. Scope limited to s/plugin/rs/** and s/** fixtures/manifests only. (Parent ticket 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES was not found when opening this ticket; noting for record.)
summary:
Normalized s/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract.

C1: Renamed the two DocumentApp structs to match PascalCase(app id)+"App" per confirmed precedent (remodel/protocol/draw all rename the struct after the string passed to App::builder, not the controller id): SHomeApp -> HomeApp (app id "home"), SStudioApp -> StudioApp (app id "studio"). Zero residual references anywhere in the crate (verified by grep and by diffing struct/fn name sets against the pre-edit backup).

C4: Split the two flat apps into `pub mod app_home` and `pub mod app_studio` per the multi-app layout rule. Genuinely shared code (parse_demo_studio_document/demo_os_document/demo_studio_projection, ensure_studio_fixtures_registered, and the DEMO_STUDIO_JSON constant) stays flat above both mods — ensure_studio_fixtures_registered is used by both Home's catalog seed and Studio's exportMedia handler, so it had to be promoted out of app_home (an earlier draft left it app_home-private and had app_studio call a nonexistent qualified path; caught and fixed during verification).

C2/C3: Exactly one literal `//#region 🔖Manifest` in the whole crate (the final `bundle()`/`plugin_exports!` composition, flat, referencing `app_home::create_home_app`/`app_home::HomeApp`/`app_studio::create_studio_app`/`app_studio::StudioApp::new`). Each app's own App::builder(...) constructor moved into its own mod under a distinctly-named `🔖HomeManifest`/`🔖StudioManifest` region (not literally "Manifest" again, to keep C2's "exactly one" true by exact string match) directly adjacent to its `🔖HomeApp`/`🔖StudioApp` impl region, matching the App-impl-then-Manifest-then-Tests tail every already-normalized single-app crate uses. Regions reordered into the canonical Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests order per mod; ad hoc region names (CatalogBackbone, HomeVfs, MediaGraphVfs, StudioPanels, CompiledDag, StudioWindows) folded into the closest canonical bucket. Tests region renamed/kept as "🧪Tests" and split per-mod (see Testkit below) since C3 doesn't impose a cardinality constraint on Tests the way C2 does on Manifest.

C5 SDK adoption:
- PanelKit: build_catalogue_tree/app_catalogue_item rewritten on `tree_item_desc` + `PanelTreeBuilder` (the boilerplate skeleton only; drag-data/icon/children logic is untouched). build_parameters_tree/build_inspector_tree already used the SDK's `ui_declarative_sections_to_tree` mechanism and were left as-is (different, already-adopted primitive). `selection_ids` doesn't apply — this crate never parses a generic `{"ids": [...]}` arg shape.
- Terminology: SHomeLabels/SStudioLabels converted to `app_labels!` macro declarations; `s_home_labels`/`s_studio_labels` resolver fns replaced by `resolve_labels::<T>(view_state)`; `s_home_action_labels`/`s_studio_action_labels` rewritten on `localized_label_map`; both `app_labels()` impls rewritten on `AppLabelsOverlay::default()` + `AppLabelsOverlayExt` fluent builder (confirmed no `.app_label()` method exists — used `.window_kind_label`/`.action_labels` only, matching what the fields actually needed).
- Testkit: removed the local `meta()` fn (every call site now uses `testkit::meta("local")`), removed the local `drain()` helper and the inline `MemoryBackbone::pair` convergence scaffolding. `undo_redo_round_trip_on_spawn` and `two_instances_converge_on_disjoint_edits_via_backbone` rewritten on `testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip`/`testkit::assert_two_instances_converge` (mirroring protocol-plugin's already-converted equivalents). `empty_history()` was left local (not one of C5's named forbidden mechanisms) and duplicated once per mod's tests, matching the "each mod fully self-contained" pattern already used by trinity/procedural/gis.

Tests: split the single flat `mod tests` into `app_home::tests` (8 tests) and `app_studio::tests` (30 tests, incl. the 2 testkit-converted tests). Two tests that asserted on both apps at once (`s_labels_resolve_native_english_by_default`/`_german_locale`, `studio_and_home_declare_expected_actions`) were split into per-app tests carrying the exact same assertions (`home_labels_resolve_native_*`/`studio_labels_resolve_native_*`, `studio_declares_expected_actions_and_examples` — the home half of the latter was already covered by the pre-existing `home_declares_create_studio_action` test, so it wasn't duplicated). Verified via a function/struct-name diff against the pre-edit backup that every removed/added test name is accounted for and no test body logic was dropped (36 -> 38 tests, net +2 from the two 1-test-into-2-tests splits).

Bugs found and fixed while normalizing (all pre-existing, not introduced by this pass):
1. `s/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml` was missing a direct `semio-framework-core` dependency even though the code references `semio_framework_core::kernel::UiDirtyScope` by full path (confirmed by comparing against puzzle-plugin, which declares it for the identical reference pattern). Added the dependency.
2. Every `UiSectionNode` (5x), `UiButtonNode` (3x) struct literal, and the one hand-built `UiTreeNode`/`UiTreeItemNode` construction in build_catalogue_tree were missing the `loading: Option<bool>` field that `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs` added to those types — this crate would not have compiled at all. Fixed the UiSectionNode/UiButtonNode literals directly (`loading: None`); the UiTreeNode/UiTreeItemNode case was fixed as a side effect of the PanelKit adoption (PanelTreeBuilder/tree_item_desc already set `loading: None` internally).

resource_kind: confirmed intentionally absent — `s` is a pure OS-shell crate (Home/Studio host other apps' resource-typed instances rather than yielding a resource kind of its own), matching protocol-plugin's precedent of no `.resource_kind(...)` call. Not added.

Verified: rustfmt --check parses the whole file cleanly (only whitespace/wrap diffs, zero syntax errors) both before and after the Cargo-dependency/HashSet/bug fixes; region-marker nesting is balanced (stack-based check, all 25 region/endregion pairs match); brace/paren counts balanced; grep-based cross-reference of every used PascalCase identifier in both mods against imports+local defs (all "missing" hits were enum variants of already-imported enums or doc-comment mentions, not real gaps — two real gaps this same pass caught: a missing `HashSet` import in app_studio's tests and the ensure_studio_fixtures_registered cross-mod path bug, both fixed); diffed the full set of `fn`/`struct`/`enum` names against the pre-edit backup to confirm zero accidental logic loss.

Skipped due to lock contention: a full `cargo check -p s-plugin` — the workspace build lock was held by ~15 other concurrent sessions' cargo processes (process-plugin, gis-plugin, vcs, flow-plugin, trinity-plugin, lowpoly-plugin, cad-plugin, draw-plugin, my own s-plugin attempts, etc.) the entire time I waited; it never progressed past "Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory". Not run to completion — left for the orchestrator's final full workspace gate.

Nothing to flag for Wave 4's SDK-primitive audit — every mechanism this crate needed (PanelKit tree builders, Terminology macro/resolver/overlay builder, Testkit harness) already existed cleanly in semio_framework_plugin with no gaps.
